title: Radial Entertainment expands paranormal focus with new FAST channel
excerpt: Oaktree Capital-backed distribution studio Radial Entertainment has launched Paranormal Chronicles, a FAST channel focused on paranormal investigations, unexplained phenomena and mystery-driven true crime.
content:
Oaktree Capital-backed distribution studio Radial Entertainment has launched Paranormal Chronicles, a FAST channel focused on paranormal investigations, unexplained phenomena and mystery-driven true crime.

Brendon Thomas

The channel is available on Google TV Freeplay, LG Channels, Plex, The Roku Channel, DISH TV, Bonusview and Sling Freestream, with Amazon Prime Video and other platforms expected to follow later this month.

Paranormal Chronicles launches with more than 500 hours of programming, including A Haunting, Death Walker with Nick Groff, Ghost Stories, Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction, Monsters & Mysteries in America, and Sam and Colby. The channel is also set to add Radial originals and further series later this year.

The launch expands Radial’s FAST and AVoD portfolio, with the company positioning the paranormal genre as both a seasonal and year-round programming proposition.

“Paranormal and unexplained mystery programming continues to drive passionate, repeat viewing across streaming platforms,” said Brendon Thomas, chief revenue officer at Radial Entertainment.

“Paranormal Chronicles gives fans a thrilling, always-on destination with a deep launch lineup that will continue to grow as we add more titles, including Radial Originals.”
